method.trend: site linear sea-level trend is fit after removing monthly seasonal effects and excluding incomplete USGS months and configured station discontinuities
method.futureFit: empirical residual exceedance probabilities evaluated at gauge sea-level scenario deltas
method.uncertainty: analytical binomial p05/p50/p95 count approximation for annual high-tide draws; no Monte Carlo sampling
method.crestHandling: official same-day crest overrides are retained; crest-only supplemental history is excluded from the daily high-tide sampling pool
